[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advises user to prioritize safety and comfort when dancing in heels.

[EVENT] User is thinking of getting dance shoes and is currently wearing sneakers to class.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provides several recommendations for stores that sell dance shoes for salsa and hip hop: Capezio, Discount Dance Supply, DanceWithMe, So Danca, and BurjuShoes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explains that Capezio has a network of authorized retailers and flagship stores in major cities, including NYC.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant states that Discount Dance Supply is primarily an online retailer but has a "Fit Guarantee" for trying on shoes at home.
